what: The event job with action message (a person wrote to one of the agent's jobs from its card, text) reaches a chat run with one line: the background job cannot read it while it runs, so the chat run answers it as a message of that person about that job (fenced, data of that person); stop and restart only when asked; 2.615.0 (#3658 / #1801): a running job of agent_job.py that takes messages (job_inbox) gets the text in its inbox instead, no chat run
